title: 第十五章 暗度陈仓第十六章 螳螂捕蝉
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
入夜，雷雨如注。
三丫房间里的灵气开始紊乱，搅动整个废丹大院的灵场。
“就是现在！”
角落破屋内，许天抓住机会，盘腿而坐。
仰头将手中五颗上品淬体丹，外加一颗刚刚炼制的尸元丹，一股脑全部吞入腹中。
轰。
尸元丹的药力率先见效，在体内形成层层薄膜，护住那原本漏风的经脉。
五颗淬体丹紧跟其后，化作五道滚滚灵气。
在许天引导，开始冲击丹田壁垒。
这一次，只许成功，不许失败！
“给我破！”
许天心中怒吼。
咔嚓！
一声只有他自己能听到脆响。
丹田内，那团气旋先是收缩，随后轰然膨胀，化作一股液态灵力，流转全身。
力量！
前所未有的力量感充斥四肢百骸。
炼气二层，成了！
许天深吸一口气，强压下想要兴奋冲动。
盘腿而坐，他现在要做的是，尽快平息体内灵气。

虽说境界上与孙管事已有一战之力，但没有功法，没有法器。
现在的他，还是一只待宰的肥羊。
必须要忍！
想罢，许天开始入定。
将那刚刚展露峥嵘气息，压制回炼气一层初期，最终进入更弱的凡人状态。
与此同时。
正房里的动静也渐渐平息。
三丫成功突破，但迎接她不是欢呼，而是孙管事紧随其后的阴森笑声。
惨叫声随之传出。
今夜，注定无眠。
......
转眼，半个月过去。
对于废丹大院的杂役们来说，地狱生活才刚开始。
三丫并没有因为突破而获得自由，反而被孙管事用更严苛手段控制，成了随时取用的炉鼎。
之前靠着两个护卫轮流双修，她才勉强支撑自己修行。
而如今，就算把全部体内有灵气的杂役都采补一遍，都跟不上消耗速度！
“死。都给我死！”
每天都有奴役被她活活吸干，扔到乱葬岗。
短短十五天，原本熙熙攘攘大院，如今只剩下不到一半人。
空气中弥漫浓烈血腥味，活下来的人个个形如枯槁，麻木眼神里透着无边恐惧。
content_en:
At night, there was a thunderstorm.
The spiritual energy in Sanya's room began to become chaotic, stirring up the spiritual field of the entire Feidan compound.
"Now!"
In the dilapidated room in the corner, Xu Tian seized the opportunity and sat cross-legged.
He raised his head and swallowed the five top-grade Body Tempering Pills in his hand, plus a newly refined Corpse Yuan Pill, into his belly.
boom.
The power of the Corpse Yuan Pill took effect first, forming layers of thin films in the body to protect the meridians that were originally leaking.
Five body tempering pills followed closely behind, turning into five billowing auras.
Under Xu Tian's guidance, he began to attack the Dantian barrier.
This time, only success is allowed, no failure is allowed!
"Break it for me!"
Xu Tian roared in his heart.
Click!
There was a snap that only he could hear.
In the dantian, the cyclone first shrank, then suddenly expanded, turning into a stream of liquid spiritual power that circulated throughout the body.
strength!
An unprecedented sense of power filled his limbs.
The second level of Qi refining is done!
Xu Tian took a deep breath and suppressed the urge to get excited.
Sitting cross-legged, what he wants to do now is to calm down the spiritual energy in his body as soon as possible.
Although he is capable of fighting against Master Sun in his realm, he has no skills and no magic weapon.
Now he is still a fat sheep waiting to be slaughtered.
You must endure it!
After thinking about it, Xu Tian began to enter concentration.
Suppress the majestic aura that was just revealed back to the early stage of Qi refining, and finally enter a weaker mortal state.
at the same time.
The commotion in the main room gradually subsided.
Sanya successfully broke through, but instead of cheers, she was greeted by the eerie laughter of Manager Sun, who followed closely behind.
Screams followed.
Tonight, I am destined to have no sleep.
...
In the blink of an eye, half a month passed.
For the handymen of the Feidan Compound, life in hell has just begun.
Sanya did not gain freedom because of her breakthrough. Instead, she was controlled by Sun Guanshi with more stringent means and became a furnace that can be used at any time.
Before, she could barely support her cultivation by relying on two guards taking turns to practice together.
But now, even if all the handymen with spiritual energy in their bodies are replenished, they still can't keep up with the consumption rate!
"Die. Die to me!"
Every day slaves were sucked alive by her and thrown into mass graves.
In just fifteen days, the originally bustling compound was now less than half full.
The air was filled with a strong smell of blood, and all the survivors were haggard, with boundless fear in their numb eyes.
